A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Sundial research and contain complete, readable main text, Appendices A–F, Tables 1–9 and Figures 1–15. Text comparison and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original Sundial forecasting results, scaling experiments, training-objective comparisons and architectural ablations, with additional results and forecasting examples in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including TSLib, GIFT-Eval and FEV evaluations, ablations and appendix forecasting examples.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same tokenization, Transformer architecture, TimeFlow training objective and sampling procedure. No method component or computational step changes.

E1.justification: TimeBench composition, the six TSLib datasets, 23 GIFT-Eval datasets and 27 FEV datasets remain unchanged. The adaptation tasks and appendix test scenarios also match.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches throughout the benchmark and ablation comparisons, including Tables 1–3 and 7–9 and Figures 4–5. No evaluated baseline is added, removed or replaced.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same forecasting horizons, model configurations, metrics and evaluation procedures. Appendix B still specifies 20 generated predictions for FEV, 100 for GIFT-Eval and 50 flow-matching steps.

E4.justification: The objective comparisons, scaling studies, sampling calibration, architectural ablations, lookback-length analysis and forecasting case studies are unchanged in Sections 5.2–5.6 and Appendices C–D.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is unchanged, including the 80% predictive intervals estimated from 20 generated predictions in Appendix D.1. No repeated-run, seed or statistical-testing information is added.

E6.justification: The numerical tables and plotted findings match, including the appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains Sundial's MASE of 0.673, CRPS of 0.472 and rank of 9.062.

T1.justification: Equation 3 changes p(...) to p_theta(...), explicitly identifying the parameters of the already-defined generative network. This is a notation clarification, with no substantive change to mathematical definitions, assumptions or derivations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about generative forecasting, trillion-point pre-training, scalability, zero-shot performance and inference efficiency.

C2.justification: The Impact Statement drops repeated references to benchmark versatility and practitioner benefits of fast inference; these interpretations remain elsewhere, including Section 5 and Appendix F. Mechanism explanations and Appendix E limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B, Table 5 and the code/checkpoint disclosures retain the same implementation, hardware, preprocessing and configuration information. The added funding acknowledgement supplies no new technical or reproducibility details.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list and research positioning remain unchanged, including comparisons with discrete tokenization, parametric forecasting objectives and other generative approaches.

P1.justification: v3 adds a State Grid Ningxia funding acknowledgement, shortens the Impact Statement, clarifies Equation 3 notation and updates the version/date stamp. The section order and remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded Acknowledgements and shortened Impact Statement cause small text-block shifts on page 9. Figures 1–15 and Tables 1–9 retain their displays, captions and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 makes a small notation clarification and adds funding attribution while trimming redundant impact prose. The methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and substantive qualifications remain unchanged, leaving overall paper quality essentially unchanged.
